knowledgeDrops.title: Did you know?
knowledgeDrops.body: AI models are like specialized brains. Each one is trained for a specific job.

knowledgeDrops.title: Privacy first
knowledgeDrops.body: Your code and conversations stay on YOUR computer. Nothing goes to the cloud.

knowledgeDrops.title: How it works
knowledgeDrops.body: The AI runs right on your machine using your GPU — that's why it's so fast.

knowledgeDrops.title: Fun fact
knowledgeDrops.body: The AI brain has billions of connections — more than stars you can see with your eyes.

knowledgeDrops.title: Hot swap
knowledgeDrops.body: You can change AI models anytime. Just open Model Control and swap.

knowledgeDrops.title: Local power
knowledgeDrops.body: No internet needed after setup. Your AI works offline, on a plane, anywhere.

knowledgeDrops.title: Your assistant
knowledgeDrops.body: Clyffy learns your coding style over time. The more you use it, the better it gets.

knowledgeDrops.title: Built for you
knowledgeDrops.body: DevPulse is designed for creators — not just developers. Anyone can use it.
